Chapter 461: Chapter 8: Taiji Rule, Cosmic Force? (Please Subscribe)

“Master’s parents and relatives did not break through to the Unity Path Stage…” Li Qing hesitated, then spoke softly.

Not having reached the Unity Path Stage, and relying on the lifespan of the Refining Void Period, they could live for at most a hundred or two hundred thousand years.

It’s impossible for them to be alive now, which means they would have passed away long ago.

“Are they all… all gone?” Lin Yuan, upon hearing this, showed no surprise and sighed inwardly.

This was actually the most common outcome. The breakthrough from the Sixth Stage Martial Tao to the Seventh Stage is immensely difficult, just as the transition from the Refining Void Period to the Unity Path Stage is.

Equally challenging.

...

Though Jun Dongjin had a Mutated Heavenly Spiritual Root, one of the rarest talents in the Central Divine China World, it was not so outstanding in the Spirit Realm.

In the Spirit Realm, apart from judging talents based on Spirit Roots, many other Dao bodies exist.

Jun Dongjin cultivated to the peak of Refining Void, but ultimately failed in his attempt to reach the Unity Path Stage and was severely injured.

Mu Lian’er did not cultivate to the peak of Refining Void, and neither did Jun Xiaoyao nor Jun Zhilan.

With Lin Yuan’s contingency plans left behind, they successfully entered Refining Void and ascended to the Spirit Realm, but their cultivation progress slowed afterward.

“How have they been?”

Lin Yuan inquired.

“They’ve been quite well. The Daode Immortal Sect has not mistreated them.”

Li Qing immediately said, not daring to harbor any designs against Jun Dongjin and the others before knowing Lin Yuan’s whereabouts.

After all, keeping Jun Dongjin and others was not even considered a burden for the vast Daode Immortal Sect, and the Cangqing Immortal even summoned them several times to preach Dao.

But transitioning from Refining Void to Unity is not something that can be achieved with just a couple of sermons or by giving enough cultivation resources.

Otherwise, everyone in the Daode Immortal Sect would be a True Immortal, not just the dozens of True Immortal anchoring it.

“Before my parents passed away, they asked me not to give up looking for you…” Li Qing spoke with a somewhat heavy voice.

“What a pity,” Lin Yuan shook his head slightly. If he had traveled through time a bit earlier, perhaps the outcome would have been different.

“In the future, if I can become a Supreme Being, I might try resurrecting them.”

Lin Yuan thought silently to himself.

Supreme Beings wield complete control over time and space rules, able to reverse time and lift previously deceased beings back to life.

Before their deaths, Jun Dongjin, Jun Zhilan, and the others reached the Refining Void stage, similar to Sixth Rank in life essence strength. Even without deliberately merging their life essence with the Spirit Realm, having lived so long, their essence had already been recorded by the Spirit Realm.

As long as Lin Yuan became a Supreme Being and arrived in this world, reversing the flow, he should be able to resurrect them.

As for their having died of natural lifespan exhaustion, even if resurrected, they would face the limits of their lifespan in a few breaths’ time.

But Lin Yuan could completely use those few breaths to extend their lifespans.

The methods to extend lifespan in the Spirit Realm are useless, but in the Main World, there are plenty.

As for the world’s backlash after resurrecting a life…

Reviving a few Sixth Rank lives and the resulting backlash is trivial for a Supreme Being.

“Also, the descendants of master’s elder brother and second sister in the Daode Immortal Sect are doing quite well…” Li Qing seemed to remember something and promptly spoke.

With Lin Yuan’s connection, Li Qing, comparable to a Seventh Stage Martial Tao, being a pillar for the Jun family’s descendants,

as long as Li Qing is alive, it’s unlikely that the Jun family’s descendants would fare poorly, and the Cangqing Immortal is also watching.

“Is that so?” Lin Yuan glanced at Li Qing.

“Master, would you like me to invite a few outstanding descendants from the Jun family to come visit you?” Li Qing tentatively asked.

“That works.” Lin Yuan pondered for a moment, after all, having some karma with the Jun family, now that he had returned, meeting them was not a bad idea.

“Alright.” Li Qing closed his eyes and began making contact immediately.

As a major general for Daode Immortal Sect in external campaigns, Li Qing naturally had ways to directly communicate with the Daode Immortal Sect.

“About master’s news, should we keep it hidden?”

After conveying the message, Li Qing cautiously asked, “Cangqing Immortal once told me that if there’s any news of master, I must tell him immediately.”

“The Cangqing Immortal… is still alive?” Lin Yuan was interested.

This old fellow’s performance still quite satisfied him – at least he didn’t kick him when he was down when he wasn’t around.

According to the information Lin Yuan had, since the days in the Central Divine China World, the Cangqing Immortal had already lived for several hundred thousand years.

With hundreds of thousands of years passing by, even a Unity Realm True Immortal at its peak probably should have expired.

“The Cangqing Immortal transcended the Heart Demon Tribulation, so he has a much longer lifespan than a normal True Immortal…”

Li Qing immediately replied.

To advance from Unity Stage to Tribulation Transcendence Stage, an Immortal cultivator needs to transcend two tribulations.

One is the Bodily Tribulation.

Another is the Heart Spirit Tribulation.

The latter is similar to the Heart Demon Tribulation.

For an Immortal cultivator, the most difficult to transcend is the Bodily Tribulation.

Most methods of the Immortal cultivator do not focus on the body, faced with the five declines of man during Bodily Tribulation, bodily decay,

there are hardly any ways to resist.

“I see…” Lin Yuan nodded.

A Unity Realm True Immortal who had passed through the Heart Spirit Tribulation, although still far from a Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King, had their spirit soul and will transformed.

Their soul’s lifespan was significantly extended.

And for a True Immortal, a decaying body can simply be replaced.

As long as the soul lives on, they can be regarded as immortal.

“No need to hide it,” Lin Yuan said calmly.

Hide it?

Why hide it?

Now that Lin Yuan had fully regained his strength and even advanced further, even among Tribulation-Transcending Celestial Kings, he was considered an extraordinary powerhouse, not inferior to a Supreme Immortal King.

Under such circumstances, there was absolutely no need to hide.
